title: Jean Monnet Scholarship Programme (JMSP)
summary: Supports academic studies at graduate or research level in EU-related fields for eligible students, professionals, and academics working or studying in Turkey.

degree_levels.notes: Target group mentions senior undergraduate students or postgraduate (Master's or PhD) students, and application requirements state graduates or PhD students.

subject_areas.notes: Fields related to the EU acquis.

institutions.notes: Host institutions are not explicitly restricted on the page.

nationality.notes: Citizens of an EU member state, Turkey or an IPA Beneficiary Country.

residence.notes: People who are currently working or studying in Turkey.

mandatory.text: Be working in the public sector, private sector, universities (as academic or administrative staff) in Turkey, or be a senior undergraduate or postgraduate (Master's or PhD) student in Turkey
Knowledge of at least one official EU language at level B2
Citizenship of an EU member state, Turkey or an IPA Beneficiary Country

funding.description: Amount of the scholarship covers tuition fees, living expenses, and a fixed amount for various expenses to be paid only once (visa-passport, educational materials, travel, study visit, registration to local authorities, health and insurance, tax liabilities). The exact amount is capped and announced in the annual call for applications.

application_rounds.notes: The application deadline can be found on the programme website (www.jeanmonnet.org.tr).

recurring_deadline_notes: Announced in the annual call for applications.

steps.text: Refer to the programme website (http://jeanmonnet.org.tr/en/about-scholarship-programme/) for the application form and further information.
Use a desktop computer to use the application portal.

sources.title: Jean Monnet Scholarship Programme (JMSP) - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: The programme allows international graduate students or researchers to conduct academic studies for 3 to 12 months, which can include studying in Germany.
